On 1 February 2025, Turkish forces conducted airstrikes targeting QSD positions in the village of Bir Haso in the countryside of Aleppo. Casualties unknown.
On 1 February 2025, Syrian police forces detained a civilian for unknown reasons, while traveling from Aleppo city to his town, coded to Afrin, in the countryside of Aleppo.
On 1 February 2025, members of the Syrian army (Sultan Suleiman Shah Brigade) arrested a shepherd on the road of Kimar in the countryside of Aleppo and seized his sheep for unknown reasons.

notes: On 1 February 2025, Israeli forces launched a drone strike targeting a vehicle in Qabatiyah (Jenin, West Bank), killing 2 Katibat Qabatiyah (PIJ) militants and injuring 3 others. One of the killed militants was a Palestinian prisoner that was released during a prisoner exchange deal in 2023. On 17 February 2025, one of the injured Palestinians succumbed to their wounds.
